verdicts.reason: Both use the same banner split: a big headline on the left, and on the right a narrow column where the subcopy wraps into five ragged centred lines ('Solstice / botanical / ...') and sits jammed against the top and right edges, with the button nearly touching the bottom edge. A is slightly worse: its headline runs from a tiny left margin until its final period almost touches the subcopy column. B's slightly smaller headline leaves a bit more left margin and a clearer gutter, but the right column is equally cramped.
